name: AbwGateway
description: API Management gateway view of every MCP request and every agent front-door request (Server 'agents'). Decision comes from the abw-gateway trace record emitted by the validate-jwt / abw-deny policy; Outcome folds in 401 / 429 / 5xx that never reach the policy trace and the front door's late refusals (token budget).
body:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ApiId startswith 'abw-'
| extend gw = parse_json(TraceRecords)[0]
| extend GatewayDecision = extract(@'decision=([a-z_]+)', 1, tostring(gw.message))
// the agent front door can refuse after its first trace record (token budget used up): the second record carries the real reason
| extend LateDeny = extract(@'decision=deny:([a-z_]+)', 1, tostring(parse_json(TraceRecords)[1].message))
| extend ResponseCode = toint(ResponseCode)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    RequestId = CorrelationId,
    Api = ApiId,
    Server = coalesce(tostring(gw.metadata.server), tostring(split(ApiId, '-')[2])),
    Method,
    Url,
    ResponseCode,
    BackendResponseCode = toint(BackendResponseCode),
    TotalTimeMs = TotalTime,
    CallerIp = CallerIpAddress,
    Decision = iff(isnotempty(LateDeny), 'deny', GatewayDecision),
    Reason = coalesce(LateDeny, tostring(gw.metadata.reason)),
    UserOid = tostring(gw.metadata.oid),
    Outcome = case(
        ResponseCode == 401, 'unauthenticated',
        ResponseCode == 429, 'rate_limited',
        ResponseCode >= 500, 'gateway_or_backend_error',
        GatewayDecision == 'deny' or isnotempty(LateDeny), 'denied',
        GatewayDecision == 'allow', 'allowed',
        'other'),
    ApimSubscription = ApimSubscriptionId

name: AbwMcpAudit
description: MCP server audit trail, one row per tool listing / call / denial. Who (Entra user + client app), what (server, tool, data class), the decision and reason, the downstream call status, and the request_id that joins every layer.
body:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where Log startswith '{' and Log has '"event"' and Log has '"request_id"'
| extend a = parse_json(Log)
| where isnotempty(tostring(a.event))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventTime = todatetime(a.ts),
    Server = tostring(a.server),
    Event = tostring(a.event),
    Tool = tostring(a.tool),
    Decision = tostring(a.decision),
    Reason = tostring(a.reason),
    UserUpn = tostring(a.user_upn),
    UserOid = tostring(a.user_oid),
    ClientAppId = tostring(a.azp),
    Audience = tostring(a.aud),
    Roles = a.roles,
    Scope = tostring(a.scp),
    OnBehalfOf = tobool(a.obo),
    DataClass = tostring(a.data_class),
    DownstreamService = tostring(a.downstream.service),
    DownstreamStatus = toint(a.downstream.status),
    DownstreamTarget = tostring(a.downstream.target),
    ArgsSha256 = tostring(a.args_sha256),
    ResultBytes = tolong(a.result_bytes),
    RequestId = tostring(a.request_id),
    TraceId = tostring(a.trace_id),
    TokenId = tostring(a.jti),
    TenantId = tostring(a.tid),
    App = ContainerAppName

name: AbwTokenUsage
description: FinOps view of agent spend: model tokens per Entra user and agent per hour, measured at the APIM agent front door (llm-emit-token-metric). It is the same identity the per-user token budget is enforced on, so a cost line and a quota line always name the same person.
body:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where Name == 'azure.ai_gateway.client.token.usage'
| extend P = parse_json(Properties)
| extend TokenType = tostring(P['gen_ai.token.type'])
| where TokenType in ('input_tokens', 'output_tokens', 'total_tokens')
| summarize
    Runs = tolong(sumif(ItemCount, TokenType == 'total_tokens')),
    InputTokens = tolong(sumif(Sum, TokenType == 'input_tokens')),
    OutputTokens = tolong(sumif(Sum, TokenType == 'output_tokens')),
    TotalTokens = tolong(sumif(Sum, TokenType == 'total_tokens')),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Hour = bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), User = tostring(P['upn']), UserOid = tostring(P['oid']), Agent = tostring(P['agent'])
| order by Hour desc, TotalTokens desc

name: AbwUsageByUser
description: How people actually use agents: calls, denials, servers and tools touched per Entra user. Rows with no user are calls that arrived without a user identity (shared-key legacy path).
body:
AbwMcpAudit(lookback)
| where Event != 'tool_listed'
| extend User = iff(isempty(UserUpn), '(no user context)', UserUpn)
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    Allowed = countif(Decision == 'allow'),
    Denied = countif(Decision == 'deny'),
    Servers = make_set(Server, 10),
    DistinctTools = dcount(Tool),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by User
| extend DenyRatePct = round(100.0 * Denied / Calls, 1)
| order by Calls desc

name: AbwZeroKeys
description: Evidence that nothing authenticates with a shared secret: every Storage data-plane request by authentication type. KeyBased must stay at zero (Entra OAuth and the service-to-service TrustedAccess path are keyless).
body:
StorageBlobLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| summarize Requests = count(), Denied = countif(StatusCode in (401, 403)), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Account = AccountName, AuthType = AuthenticationType
| extend KeyBased = AuthType in ('AccountKey', 'SAS', 'AccountSas', 'ServiceSas', 'DelegationSas')
| order by Account asc, Requests desc

name: AbwAgentActivity
description: Which agent called which MCP tool for which user and what was decided, plus every agent run the Foundry guardrail stopped. Foundry traces carry the agent and tool; the MCP audit and the APIM gateway carry the human. request_id (echoed in every tool result) is the join key; the user is resolved from the MCP audit, else from the gateway-validated Entra object id. RunBy is who started the agent run (the caller of the agent, which can differ from the identity the tool saw). Guardrail says what the Foundry content filter caught and where: prompt, tool call, tool result or model output. A run stopped before any tool was called is one row with no Tool and RequestId = the trace id.
body:
let oidToUpn = AbwMcpAudit(lookback)
    | where isnotempty(UserOid) and isnotempty(UserUpn)
    | summarize MappedUpn = take_any(UserUpn) by GatewayUserOid = UserOid;
let calls = AppGenAIContent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where isnotempty(tostring(ToolCallResult)) or isnotempty(tostring(ToolCallArguments))
    | extend RequestId = extract(@'"request_id"\s*:\s*"([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})"', 1, tostring(ToolCallResult))
    | summarize
        TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated),
        ToolArguments = take_any(tostring(ToolCallArguments)),
        RequestId = take_anyif(RequestId, isnotempty(RequestId))
        by AgentName, TraceId, SpanId;
let spans = AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where Name startswith 'execute_tool'
    | project
        TraceId = OperationId,
        SpanId = Id,
        Tool = substring(Name, strlen('execute_tool ')),
        DurationMs,
        SpanSucceeded = Success,
        AgentVersion = tostring(Properties['gen_ai.agent.version']),
        ToolCallId = tostring(Properties['gen_ai.tool.call.id']);
let audit = AbwMcpAudit(lookback)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, UserUpn, Decision, Reason, Server, DataClass, OnBehalfOf) by RequestId;
let gateway = AbwGateway(lookback)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, UserOid) by RequestId
    | project RequestId, GatewayUserOid = UserOid;
// one row per agent run (the invoke_agent span): who started it and, for runs the guardrail stopped, the content-filter verdicts
let runs = AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where Name startswith 'invoke_agent'
    | extend IsBlock = tostring(Properties['error.type']) == 'content_filter'
    | summarize
        RunTime = min(TimeGenerated),
        RunAgent = take_any(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.agent.name'])),
        RunAgentVersion = take_any(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.agent.version'])),
        RunOid = take_any(tostring(Properties['user.id'])),
        RunDurationMs = max(DurationMs),
        Blocks = countif(IsBlock),
        Verdicts = take_anyif(tostring(Properties['microsoft.foundry.content_filter.results']), IsBlock)
        by TraceId = OperationId
    | extend Stopped = Blocks > 0
    | join kind=leftouter oidToUpn on $left.RunOid == $right.GatewayUserOid
    | project TraceId, RunTime, RunAgent, RunAgentVersion, RunDurationMs, Stopped, Verdicts, RunBy = coalesce(MappedUpn, RunOid);
// every point where the filter blocked: the stage, what it flagged and, for tool stages, which tool call it was
let points = runs
    | where Stopped
    | extend verdicts = parse_json(Verdicts)
    | mv-expand entry = verdicts
    | where tobool(entry.blocked) == true
    | extend res = entry.content_filter_results
    | mv-apply k = bag_keys(res) to typeof(string) on (
        where tobool(res[k].filtered) == true or tobool(res[k].detected) == true
        | summarize flagged = make_list(k))
    | project
        TraceId,
        CallId = tostring(entry.tool_call_id),
        Point = strcat(
            iff(array_length(flagged) > 0, strcat_array(flagged, ', '), 'blocked'),
            ' on ',
            case(
                tostring(entry.source_type) == 'prompt', 'prompt',
                tostring(entry.source_type) == 'pre_tool', 'tool call',
                tostring(entry.source_type) == 'post_tool', 'tool result',
                tostring(entry.source_type) == 'completion', 'model output',
                'run'));
let pointsByCall = points
    | where isnotempty(CallId)
    | summarize GuardrailCall = strcat_array(make_set(Point), '; ') by TraceId, ToolCallId = CallId;
let pointsByRun = points
    | summarize
        GuardrailAll = strcat_array(make_set(Point), '; '),
        GuardrailRun = strcat_array(make_set_if(Point, isempty(CallId)), '; '),
        CallLevel = countif(isnotempty(CallId))
        by TraceId;
// a stopped run always gets text: when the verdicts cannot be read it degrades to 'content_filter' instead of vanishing
let guardRuns = runs
    | where Stopped
    | lookup kind=leftouter pointsByRun on TraceId
    | extend
        GuardrailAll = coalesce(GuardrailAll, 'content_filter'),
        GuardrailRun = case(isnotempty(GuardrailRun), GuardrailRun, CallLevel > 0, '', 'content_filter');
let activity = calls
    | join kind=leftouter spans on TraceId, SpanId
    | join kind=leftouter audit on RequestId
    | join kind=leftouter gateway on RequestId
    | join kind=leftouter oidToUpn on GatewayUserOid
    | lookup kind=leftouter (runs | project TraceId, RunBy) on TraceId
    | lookup kind=leftouter (guardRuns | project TraceId, GuardrailRun) on TraceId
    | lookup kind=leftouter pointsByCall on TraceId, ToolCallId
    | extend Guardrail = case(isnotempty(GuardrailCall), GuardrailCall, isnotempty(GuardrailRun), GuardrailRun, '')
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Agent = AgentName,
        AgentVersion,
        Tool,
        User = coalesce(iff(isnotempty(UserUpn), UserUpn, ''), iff(isnotempty(MappedUpn), MappedUpn, ''), iff(isnotempty(GatewayUserOid), GatewayUserOid, ''), '(not resolved)'),
        Decision = case(isnotempty(Decision), Decision, isnotempty(Guardrail), 'guardrail_blocked', ''),
        Reason = case(isnotempty(Reason), Reason, isnotempty(Guardrail), 'content_filter', ''),
        Server,
        DataClass,
        OnBehalfOf,
        DurationMs,
        ToolArguments,
        RequestId,
        TraceId,
        RunBy = coalesce(RunBy, ''),
        Guardrail;
// runs stopped before any tool was called have no tool-call row; without this they would be invisible here
let guardrailOnly = guardRuns
    | join kind=leftanti (calls | distinct TraceId) on TraceId
    | project
        TimeGenerated = RunTime,
        Agent = RunAgent,
        AgentVersion = RunAgentVersion,
        Tool = '',
        User = iff(isnotempty(RunBy), RunBy, '(not resolved)'),
        Decision = 'guardrail_blocked',
        Reason = 'content_filter',
        Server = '',
        DataClass = '',
        OnBehalfOf = bool(null),
        DurationMs = RunDurationMs,
        ToolArguments = '',
        RequestId = TraceId,
        TraceId,
        RunBy = coalesce(RunBy, ''),
        Guardrail = GuardrailAll;
union activity, guardrailOnly
| order by TimeGenerated desc

name: AbwDenials
description: Every refusal across all four defence layers in one stream: 0 Foundry guardrail, 1 APIM gateway, 2 MCP server policy, 3 data-plane RBAC on the signed-in user (Storage). Same columns everywhere so an investigator can read it top to bottom.
body:
let guardRuns = AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where Name startswith 'invoke_agent' and tostring(Properties['error.type']) == 'content_filter'
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Name,
        OperationId,
        Agent = tostring(Properties['gen_ai.agent.name']),
        Verdicts = tostring(Properties['microsoft.foundry.content_filter.results']);
// where the filter caught it (prompt, tool call, tool result, model output) and what it flagged; a run whose verdicts cannot be read keeps a plain Control
let guardCaught = guardRuns
    | extend verdicts = parse_json(Verdicts)
    | mv-expand entry = verdicts
    | where tobool(entry.blocked) == true
    | extend res = entry.content_filter_results
    | mv-apply k = bag_keys(res) to typeof(string) on (
        where tobool(res[k].filtered) == true or tobool(res[k].detected) == true
        | summarize flagged = make_list(k))
    | extend Point = strcat(
        iff(array_length(flagged) > 0, strcat_array(flagged, ', '), 'blocked'),
        ' on ',
        case(
            tostring(entry.source_type) == 'prompt', 'prompt',
            tostring(entry.source_type) == 'pre_tool', 'tool call',
            tostring(entry.source_type) == 'post_tool', 'tool result',
            tostring(entry.source_type) == 'completion', 'model output',
            'run'))
    | summarize Caught = strcat_array(make_set(Point), '; ') by OperationId;
let guardrail = guardRuns
    | lookup kind=leftouter guardCaught on OperationId
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Layer = '0-agent-guardrail',
        Control = iff(isnotempty(Caught), strcat('Foundry guardrail: ', Caught), 'Foundry guardrail'),
        Principal = Agent,
        Target = Name,
        Reason = 'content_filter',
        RequestId = OperationId;
// the gateway only sees the token's oid; map it to the UPN the MCP servers log so one person is one Principal across layers
let oidToUpn = AbwMcpAudit(lookback)
    | where isnotempty(UserOid) and isnotempty(UserUpn)
    | summarize MappedUpn = take_any(UserUpn) by UserOid;
let gateway = AbwGateway(lookback)
    | where Outcome in ('denied', 'unauthenticated', 'rate_limited')
    | lookup kind=leftouter oidToUpn on UserOid
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Layer = '1-gateway',
        Control = case(Outcome == 'unauthenticated', 'validate-jwt', Outcome == 'rate_limited', 'rate-limit-by-key', Reason == 'token_quota', 'llm-token-limit', 'abw-deny claim policy'),
        Principal = coalesce(MappedUpn, UserOid, ''),
        Target = strcat(Server, ' ', Method),
        Reason = case(Outcome == 'unauthenticated', 'no_valid_token', Outcome == 'rate_limited', 'rate_limit', Reason),
        RequestId;
let mcp = AbwMcpAudit(lookback)
    | where Decision == 'deny'
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Layer = '2-mcp-server',
        Control = Event,
        Principal = UserUpn,
        Target = strcat(Server, '.', Tool),
        Reason,
        RequestId;
let dataplane = StorageBlobLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where StatusCode in (401, 403)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Layer = '3-data-plane',
        Control = strcat('Storage ', AuthenticationType, ' / Azure RBAC'),
        Principal = coalesce(RequesterUpn, RequesterObjectId, '(anonymous)'),
        Target = strcat(AccountName, ' ', OperationName),
        Reason = tostring(StatusText),
        RequestId = ClientRequestId;
union guardrail, gateway, mcp, dataplane
| order by TimeGenerated desc

name: AbwFullChainCore
description: Everything one run touched in this workspace, in time order, from ANY of its ids: the tool-call request_id on the board, the front-door request id, or the W3C trace id. APIM front door, Foundry guardrail / agent / model / tool calls, APIM MCP gateway, MCP server audit (with the Entra token id each call carried), data plane (Storage exact by request_id; Search and Cosmos matched by time to the MCP call), APIM policy exceptions and Sentinel alerts. AbwFullChain adds the Entra sign-in and token-issue rows, which live in the Entra sign-in export, not here.
body:
let qid = tolower(trim(@'\s+', anyId));
let gw = materialize(AbwGateway(lookback));
let aud = materialize(AbwMcpAudit(lookback));
let uMap = aud
    | where isnotempty(UserOid) and isnotempty(UserUpn)
    | summarize UserUpn = take_any(UserUpn) by UserOid;
// an APIM gateway-log row and its APIM request telemetry carry the same TimeGenerated: that maps every APIM request id to its W3C trace id
let gwTrace = materialize(
    gw
    | join kind=inner (
        AppRequests
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) and AppRoleName startswith 'apim'
        | project TimeGenerated, TraceId = OperationId
      ) on TimeGenerated
    | summarize TraceId = take_any(TraceId) by RequestId);
// every Foundry tool result echoes the MCP request_id: that maps each tool span to its APIM / MCP / data-plane rows
let toolRid = materialize(
    AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) and Name startswith 'execute_tool'
    | extend Rid = extract(@'"request_id"\s*:\s*"([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})"', 1, tostring(Properties['gen_ai.tool.call.result']))
    | where isnotempty(Rid)
    | project Rid, TraceId = OperationId);
let tr = toscalar(
    union
        (gwTrace | where RequestId == qid | project TraceId),
        (aud | where RequestId == qid or TraceId == qid | project TraceId),
        (toolRid | where Rid == qid | project TraceId),
        (print TraceId = qid | where TraceId matches regex @'^[0-9a-f]{32}$')
    | where isnotempty(TraceId)
    | summarize Traces = make_set(TraceId));
let trk = array_concat(tr, dynamic(['~none~']));
let rids = toscalar(
    union
        (print RequestId = qid),
        (gwTrace | where TraceId in (trk) | project RequestId),
        (aud | where TraceId in (trk) | project RequestId),
        (toolRid | where TraceId in (trk) | project RequestId = Rid)
    | where isnotempty(RequestId)
    | summarize Ids = make_set(RequestId));
let rk = array_concat(rids, dynamic(['~none~']));
let ak = array_concat(rk, trk);
let mcpLog = ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | summarize McpMethod = take_any(Method), ToolName = take_any(ToolName), ToolCount = take_any(ToolCount) by RequestId = CorrelationId;
let gwx = gw
    | where RequestId in (rk)
    | lookup (mcpLog) on RequestId
    | lookup (uMap) on UserOid
    | lookup (gwTrace) on RequestId
    | extend Verdict = iff(Outcome == 'allowed' and toint(ResponseCode) >= 400, 'passed the gateway, backend refused', Outcome)
    | extend GwDetail = strcat('HTTP ', ResponseCode, ' ', Verdict, iff(isnotempty(Reason) and Reason != 'ok', strcat(' (', Reason, ')'), ''), ' | backend=', BackendResponseCode, ' | ', TotalTimeMs, 'ms');
let frontdoor = gwx
    | where Api == 'abw-agent-frontdoor'
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 1,
        Layer = 'APIM front door',
        Actor = coalesce(UserUpn, UserOid, ''),
        Action = strcat(Method, ' ', Server, ' front door'),
        Detail = GwDetail,
        RequestId,
        TraceId;
// allowed tools/list and server/discover calls are noise here: they are summarised in the discovery row
let apimTool = gwx
    | where Api != 'abw-agent-frontdoor'
    | where not(McpMethod in ('tools/list', 'server/discover') and toint(ResponseCode) < 400)
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 7,
        Layer = 'APIM gateway',
        Actor = coalesce(UserUpn, UserOid, ''),
        Action = strcat(Method, ' ', Server, iff(isnotempty(McpMethod), strcat(' ', McpMethod), ''), iff(isnotempty(ToolName), strcat(' ', ToolName), '')),
        Detail = GwDetail,
        RequestId,
        TraceId;
let spans = AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) and OperationId in (trk)
    | where Name startswith 'invoke_agent' or Name startswith 'execute_tool' or Name startswith 'chat ';
let invokes = spans | where Name startswith 'invoke_agent';
let guardPoints = invokes
    | extend cf = parse_json(tostring(Properties['microsoft.foundry.content_filter.results']))
    | mv-expand with_itemindex = i entry = cf
    | extend src = tostring(entry.source_type), blocked = tobool(entry.blocked), res = entry.content_filter_results
    | mv-apply k = bag_keys(res) to typeof(string) on (
        where tobool(res[k].filtered) == true or tobool(res[k].detected) == true
        | summarize flagged = make_list(k))
    | extend Point = strcat(src, iff(blocked, strcat(' BLOCKED (', strcat_array(flagged, ', '), ')'), ' ok'))
    | project TimeGenerated, OperationId, i, Point, blocked;
// Defender for AI and Purview run inside the Foundry content filter: list the ones that did not return a verdict
let guardUnavailable = invokes
    | extend cf = parse_json(tostring(Properties['microsoft.foundry.content_filter.results']))
    | mv-expand entry = cf
    | extend res = entry.content_filter_results
    | mv-apply k = bag_keys(res) to typeof(string) on (
        where tostring(res[k].details.evaluation) == 'unavailable'
        | project Provider = k)
    | summarize Unavailable = make_set(Provider) by OperationId;
let guard = guardPoints
    | order by OperationId asc, i asc
    | summarize Time = min(TimeGenerated), Points = make_list(Point), AnyBlocked = max(toint(blocked)) by OperationId
    | lookup (guardUnavailable) on OperationId
    | project
        Time,
        Step = 3,
        Layer = 'Foundry guardrail',
        Actor = 'Foundry content filter',
        Action = iff(AnyBlocked == 1, 'BLOCKED', 'passed'),
        Detail = strcat(strcat_array(Points, ' | '), iff(array_length(Unavailable) > 0, strcat(' | no verdict from: ', strcat_array(Unavailable, ', ')), '')),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = OperationId;
let agent = invokes
    | extend UserOid = tostring(Properties['user.id']), Blueprint = tostring(Properties['microsoft.a365.agent.blueprint.id'])
    | lookup (uMap) on UserOid
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 4,
        Layer = 'Foundry agent',
        Actor = substring(Name, strlen('invoke_agent ')),
        Action = case(tostring(Properties['error.type']) == 'content_filter', 'run stopped by the guardrail', Success, 'run completed', 'run failed'),
        Detail = strcat('for ', coalesce(UserUpn, UserOid, 'unknown user'), ' | ', toint(DurationMs), 'ms', iff(isnotempty(Blueprint), strcat(' | Agent 365 blueprint ', substring(Blueprint, 0, 8)), '')),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = OperationId;
let model = spans
    | where Name startswith 'chat '
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 5,
        Layer = 'Foundry model',
        Actor = coalesce(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.request.model']), substring(Name, strlen('chat '))),
        Action = 'chat completion',
        Detail = strcat('tokens in=', coalesce(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), '0'), ' out=', coalesce(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), '0'), ' cached=', coalesce(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.usage.cached_tokens']), '0'), ' | ', toint(DurationMs), 'ms'),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = OperationId;
let tools = spans
    | where Name startswith 'execute_tool'
    | extend Rid = extract(@'"request_id"\s*:\s*"([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})"', 1, tostring(Properties['gen_ai.tool.call.result']))
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 6,
        Layer = 'Foundry tool call',
        Actor = coalesce(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.agent.name']), ''),
        Action = substring(Name, strlen('execute_tool ')),
        Detail = strcat('args ', substring(tostring(Properties['gen_ai.tool.call.arguments']), 0, 100), ' | ', toint(DurationMs), 'ms', iff(Success, '', ' | FAILED')),
        RequestId = Rid,
        TraceId = OperationId;
let mcpRows = aud
    | where (RequestId in (rk) or TraceId in (trk)) and Event != 'tool_listed'
    | project
        Time = coalesce(EventTime, TimeGenerated),
        Step = 8,
        Layer = 'MCP server',
        Actor = UserUpn,
        Action = strcat(Server, '.', Tool, ' [', Event, ']', iff(Server == 'private', ' direct VNet path, no APIM', '')),
        Detail = strcat(Decision, iff(isnotempty(Reason), strcat(' (', Reason, ')'), ''), iff(isnotempty(DownstreamService), strcat(' | downstream ', DownstreamService, ' ', DownstreamStatus), ''), ' | obo=', OnBehalfOf, ' class=', DataClass, ' client=', ClientAppId, ' roles=', tostring(Roles), iff(isnotempty(TokenId), strcat(' | token ', TokenId), '')),
        RequestId,
        TraceId,
        TokenId;
let discovery = aud
    | where (RequestId in (rk) or TraceId in (trk)) and Event == 'tool_listed'
    | summarize Tools = dcount(Tool), t0 = min(coalesce(EventTime, TimeGenerated)), Upn = take_any(UserUpn), Tid = take_any(TraceId) by Server
    | summarize Time = min(t0), Listed = array_sort_asc(make_list(strcat(Server, ' ', Tools))), Servers = count(), Upn = take_any(Upn), TraceId = take_any(Tid)
    | where Servers > 0
    | project
        Time,
        Step = 2,
        Layer = 'Tool discovery',
        Actor = Upn,
        Action = strcat('tools/list on ', Servers, ' MCP servers'),
        Detail = strcat('tools visible to this user: ', strcat_array(Listed, ' | ')),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId;
let storage = StorageBlobLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) and ClientRequestId in (rk)
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 9,
        Layer = 'Storage data plane',
        Actor = coalesce(RequesterUpn, RequesterObjectId, ''),
        Action = strcat(OperationName, ' ', tostring(split(Uri, '?')[0])),
        Detail = strcat('HTTP ', StatusCode, ' ', StatusText, ' | auth=', AuthenticationType, ' app=', RequesterAppId),
        RequestId = ClientRequestId,
        TraceId = '';
// Search and Cosmos logs carry no caller id: match them to the MCP call that used them by time.
// The APIM log row is stamped when the request starts, so [start, start + total time] is the window the MCP server worked in.
let dataCalls = aud
    | where (RequestId in (rk) or TraceId in (trk)) and Event != 'tool_listed' and DownstreamService in ('search', 'cosmos')
    | project RequestId, TraceId, DownstreamService, ET = coalesce(EventTime, TimeGenerated)
    | join kind=leftouter (gw | project RequestId, GwStart = TimeGenerated, GwMs = todouble(TotalTimeMs)) on RequestId
    | extend WinStart = coalesce(GwStart, ET - 2s) - 200ms, WinEnd = coalesce(GwStart + GwMs * 1ms, ET) + 400ms
    | project RequestId, TraceId, DownstreamService, ET, WinStart, WinEnd;
let wLo = toscalar(dataCalls | summarize min(WinStart));
let wHi = toscalar(dataCalls | summarize max(WinEnd));
let searchRows = dataCalls
    | where DownstreamService == 'search'
    | extend k = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        AzureDiagnostics
        | where TimeGenerated between (wLo .. wHi)
        | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SEARCH' and OperationName startswith 'Query.'
        | project STime = TimeGenerated, Service = Resource, Op = OperationName, Code = toint(resultSignature_d), Docs = toint(Documents_d), Ms = toint(DurationMs), Idx = IndexName_s, Q = substring(Query_s, 0, 150)
        | extend k = 1
      ) on k
    | where STime between (WinStart .. WinEnd)
    | extend Gap = abs(ET - STime)
    | summarize arg_min(Gap, STime, Service, Op, Code, Docs, Ms, Idx, Q) by RequestId, TraceId
    | project
        Time = STime,
        Step = 9,
        Layer = 'Search data plane',
        Actor = Service,
        Action = strcat(Op, ' ', Idx),
        Detail = strcat('HTTP ', Code, ' | ', Docs, ' docs | ', Ms, 'ms | ', Q, ' | matched by time (Search logs carry no caller id)'),
        RequestId,
        TraceId;
let cosmosRows = dataCalls
    | where DownstreamService == 'cosmos'
    | extend k = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        CDBDataPlaneRequests
        | where TimeGenerated between (wLo .. wHi) and DatabaseName == 'abw'
        | project CTime = TimeGenerated, Coll = CollectionName, Code = tostring(StatusCode), RU = todouble(RequestCharge)
        | extend k = 1
      ) on k
    | where CTime between (WinStart .. WinEnd)
    | summarize Time = min(CTime), Calls = count(), RUs = sum(RU), Colls = make_set(Coll), Codes = make_set(Code) by RequestId, TraceId
    | project
        Time,
        Step = 9,
        Layer = 'Cosmos data plane',
        Actor = 'MCP server managed identity',
        Action = strcat(Calls, ' requests on ', strcat_array(Colls, ', ')),
        Detail = strcat('status ', strcat_array(Codes, ','), ' | ', round(RUs, 1), ' RU | matched by time (Cosmos logs carry no caller id)'),
        RequestId,
        TraceId;
let policy = AppExceptions
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) and OperationId in (trk)
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 10,
        Layer = 'APIM policy',
        Actor = '',
        Action = ExceptionType,
        Detail = substring(OuterMessage, 0, 160),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = OperationId;
let alertRaw = SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where tostring(ExtendedProperties) has_any (ak)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, Status), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by SystemAlertId;
let alerts = alertRaw
    | summarize Time = min(FirstSeen), Fires = count(), Sev = take_any(AlertSeverity), St = take_any(Status) by AlertName
    | project
        Time,
        Step = 11,
        Layer = 'Sentinel alert',
        Actor = 'Sentinel analytics rule',
        Action = AlertName,
        Detail = strcat(Sev, ' | ', St, ' | raised ', Fires, iff(Fires == 1, ' time', ' times')),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = '';
let alertIds = array_concat(coalesce(toscalar(alertRaw | summarize make_set(SystemAlertId)), dynamic([])), dynamic(['~none~']));
// each incident row sits at the first of this run's alerts that the incident groups
let incidents = SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where tostring(AlertIds) has_any (alertIds)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Title, Severity, Status, CreatedTime, AlertIds) by IncidentNumber
    | mv-expand AlertId = todynamic(AlertIds) to typeof(string)
    | join kind=inner (alertRaw | project AlertId = SystemAlertId, AlertFirstSeen = FirstSeen) on AlertId
    | summarize AlertTime = min(AlertFirstSeen), Title = take_any(Title), Severity = take_any(Severity), Status = take_any(Status), CreatedTime = take_any(CreatedTime) by IncidentNumber
    | project
        Time = AlertTime,
        Step = 12,
        Layer = 'Sentinel incident',
        Actor = 'Sentinel',
        Action = strcat('Incident #', IncidentNumber, ' ', Title),
        Detail = strcat(Severity, ' | ', Status, ' | opened ', format_datetime(CreatedTime, 'MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC (an incident groups the alerts of its rule)'),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = '';
union frontdoor, discovery, guard, agent, model, tools, apimTool, mcpRows, storage, searchRows, cosmosRows, policy, alerts, incidents
| extend TraceId = coalesce(TraceId, tostring(tr[0]))
| order by Time asc, Step asc
| project Time, Step, Layer, Actor, Action, Detail, RequestId, TraceId, TokenId

name: AbwIdentityChain
description: The audit answer for ONE request_id: the full chain from the Foundry agent, through the APIM gateway and the MCP server, to the Storage data plane, with the identity each hop saw. Paste a request_id from any denial or tool result.
body:
let rid = requestId;
let agent = AppGenAIContent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where tostring(ToolCallResult) has rid
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 1,
        Layer = 'Foundry agent',
        Actor = AgentName,
        Action = 'tool result returned to the model',
        Detail = strcat('trace=', TraceId, ' span=', SpanId),
        RequestId = rid;
let gateway = AbwGateway(lookback)
    | where RequestId == rid
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 2,
        Layer = 'APIM gateway',
        Actor = coalesce(UserOid, ''),
        Action = strcat(Method, ' ', Server),
        Detail = strcat('HTTP ', ResponseCode, ' ', Outcome, iff(isnotempty(Reason) and Reason != 'ok', strcat(' (', Reason, ')'), ''), ' backend=', BackendResponseCode, ' ', TotalTimeMs, 'ms'),
        RequestId;
let mcpRaw = AbwMcpAudit(lookback) | where RequestId == rid;
// the MCP SDK re-lists tools while serving a tools/call; keep tool_listed rows only for genuine tools/list requests
let hasAction = toscalar(mcpRaw | where Event != 'tool_listed' | count) > 0;
let mcp = mcpRaw
    | where not(hasAction and Event == 'tool_listed')
    | project
        Time = EventTime,
        Step = 3,
        Layer = 'MCP server',
        Actor = UserUpn,
        Action = strcat(Server, '.', Tool, ' [', Event, ']'),
        Detail = strcat(Decision, iff(isnotempty(Reason), strcat(' (', Reason, ')'), ''), ' obo=', OnBehalfOf, ' class=', DataClass, ' client=', ClientAppId, ' roles=', tostring(Roles)),
        RequestId;
let storage = StorageBlobLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where ClientRequestId == rid
    | project
        Time = TimeGenerated,
        Step = 4,
        Layer = 'Storage data plane',
        Actor = coalesce(RequesterUpn, RequesterObjectId),
        Action = strcat(OperationName, ' ', tostring(split(Uri, '?')[0])),
        Detail = strcat('HTTP ', StatusCode, ' ', StatusText, ' auth=', AuthenticationType, ' app=', RequesterAppId),
        RequestId = ClientRequestId;
union agent, gateway, mcp, storage
| order by Step asc, Time asc

name: AbwFullChain
description: The whole run for one id, Entra included: AbwFullChainCore plus the sign-in that started the session (password, MFA) and the token each MCP server accepted (Conditional Access verdicts, location), read from the Entra sign-in export and joined on the token id the MCP audit records. A token is reused until it expires, so the sign-in can be days older than the call: set the time range to 30 days. tokenIds is optional: the token ids (uti claims, comma separated) a caller sent, for a call the gateway refused before any MCP server logged its token. Deployed without an Entra workspace it is AbwFullChainCore.
body:
let core = materialize(AbwFullChainCore(anyId, lookback));
let sent = iff(isempty(tokenIds), dynamic([]), split(tokenIds, ','));
let toks = array_concat(coalesce(toscalar(core | where isnotempty(TokenId) | summarize make_set(TokenId)), dynamic([])), sent, dynamic(['~none~']));
// the two Entra sign-in tables; deployed with an Entra workspace id they are read from that workspace (infra\06b-observability.bicep)
let entraNonInteractive = AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs;
let entraInteractive = SigninLogs;
// the two tables disagree on column types (string in one, dynamic in the other): give each the same shape before they meet
// (a function over any table cannot name its columns, hence column_ifexists)
let shape = (t:(*)) {
    t
    | project
        TokenId = tostring(column_ifexists('UniqueTokenIdentifier', '')),
        SessionId = tostring(column_ifexists('SessionId', '')),
        STime = todatetime(column_ifexists('CreatedDateTime', datetime(null))),
        Upn = tostring(column_ifexists('UserPrincipalName', '')),
        App = tostring(column_ifexists('AppDisplayName', '')),
        Resource = tostring(column_ifexists('ResourceDisplayName', '')),
        Result = tostring(column_ifexists('ResultType', '')),
        Protocol = tostring(column_ifexists('AuthenticationProtocol', '')),
        Requirement = tostring(column_ifexists('AuthenticationRequirement', '')),
        CaStatus = tostring(column_ifexists('ConditionalAccessStatus', '')),
        Policies = todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists('ConditionalAccessPolicies', ''))),
        AuthSteps = todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists('AuthenticationDetails', ''))),
        Loc = todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists('LocationDetails', '')))
};
// reads the Conditional Access verdicts, the authentication steps and the place out of the JSON a sign-in row carries
let explain = (t:(TokenId:string, SessionId:string, STime:datetime, Upn:string, App:string, Resource:string, Result:string, Protocol:string, Requirement:string, CaStatus:string, Policies:dynamic, AuthSteps:dynamic, Loc:dynamic)) {
    t
    | mv-apply p = Policies on (
        where tostring(p.result) !in ('', 'notApplied', 'notEnabled', 'reportOnlyNotApplied')
        | summarize Ca = make_set(strcat(tostring(p.displayName), ' = ', tostring(p.result))))
    | mv-apply s = AuthSteps on (
        extend Method = tostring(s.authenticationMethod), Said = tostring(s.authenticationStepResultDetail)
        | where tostring(s.succeeded) =~ 'true'
        | summarize
            Steps = make_list(strcat(coalesce(Method, Said), iff(isnotempty(Method) and isnotempty(Said), strcat(': ', Said), ''))),
            Methods = make_list_if(coalesce(Method, Said), Method != 'Previously satisfied'))
    | extend
        City = tostring(Loc.city),
        Country = tostring(Loc.countryOrRegion),
        Needs = case(Requirement == 'multiFactorAuthentication', 'MFA required', Requirement == 'singleFactorAuthentication', 'single factor', Requirement)
};
let caText = (ca:dynamic) { iff(array_length(ca) > 0, strcat(' [', strcat_array(ca, '; '), ']'), '') };
// every token the MCP servers saw on this run: one row per token id (a refresh-token redemption is a non-interactive sign-in)
let tokenRaw = materialize(
    union
        (entraNonInteractive | where UniqueTokenIdentifier in (toks) and CreatedDateTime > ago(lookback + 2d) | invoke shape()),
        (entraInteractive | where UniqueTokenIdentifier in (toks) and CreatedDateTime > ago(lookback + 2d) | invoke shape())
    | summarize arg_min(STime, *) by TokenId
    | invoke explain());
let tokenRows = tokenRaw
    | project
        Time = STime,
        Step = 0,
        Layer = 'Entra token issued',
        Actor = Upn,
        Action = strcat(App, ' was issued a token for ', Resource),
        Detail = strcat(
            iff(array_length(Steps) > 0, strcat(strcat_array(Steps, ' + '), ' | '), ''),
            Needs,
            ' | Conditional Access ', CaStatus, caText(Ca),
            iff(isnotempty(City), strcat(' | ', City, ', ', Country), ''),
            ' | token ', TokenId,
            iff(isnotempty(SessionId), strcat(' | session ', substring(SessionId, 0, 8)), '')),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = '';
// the interactive sign-in(s) of each session those tokens belong to: the login that earned the refresh token, often days earlier
let sess = array_concat(coalesce(toscalar(tokenRaw | where isnotempty(SessionId) | summarize make_set(SessionId)), dynamic([])), dynamic(['~none~']));
let loginRaw = entraInteractive
    | where SessionId in (sess) and CreatedDateTime > ago(90d)
    | invoke shape()
    | invoke explain()
    | extend NMethods = array_length(Methods);
// one row per session: the first successful sign-in's time, and the steps of the attempt that actually asked for them (a device-code login logs those on its first row)
let loginRows = loginRaw
    | summarize
        FirstOk = minif(STime, Result == '0'),
        FirstAny = min(STime),
        App = take_anyif(App, Result == '0'),
        Protocol = take_anyif(Protocol, Result == '0' and Protocol != 'none'),
        arg_max(NMethods, Upn, Steps, Methods, Needs, CaStatus, Ca)
        by SessionId
    | project
        Time = coalesce(FirstOk, FirstAny),
        Step = 0,
        Layer = 'Entra sign-in',
        Actor = Upn,
        Action = strcat('signed in to ', App, iff(array_length(Methods) > 0, strcat(' with ', strcat_array(Methods, ' + ')), ' (MFA satisfied by an earlier sign-in)')),
        Detail = strcat(
            iff(array_length(Steps) > 0, strcat(strcat_array(Steps, ' + '), ' | '), ''),
            Needs,
            ' | Conditional Access ', CaStatus, caText(Ca),
            iff(isnotempty(Protocol), strcat(' | ', Protocol, ' flow'), ''),
            ' | session ', substring(SessionId, 0, 8)),
        RequestId = '',
        TraceId = '';
union (core | project-away TokenId), tokenRows, loginRows
| order by Time asc, Step asc
| project Time, Step, Layer, Actor, Action, Detail, RequestId, TraceId
